name: Apify
one_liner: Apify provides a RESTful API for programmatic access to its platform, including Actors, datasets, and storage.
auth_notes: Apify API uses an API token passed in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
access_notes: API tokens are available to all users after signing up and can be found on the API & Integrations page in the Apify Console.

extras.rate_limits: The default per-resource rate limit is 60 requests per second per resource, which in this context means a single Actor, a single Actor run, a single dataset, single key-value store etc.

evidence.snippet: The Apify API (version 2) provides programmatic access to the Apify platform.
- Add the token to your request's `Authorization` header as `Bearer `.
The Apify API (version 2) provides programmatic access to the Apify platform. The API is organized around RESTful HTTP endpoints.
The Apify's MCP server (mcp.apify.com) allows AI applications and agents to interact with the Apify platform using Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- An Apify account - Sign up for an Apify account, if you don't have one.
